breakdown.description: The re-entrant cutout faces are turned from natural boundaries into artificial clamps
breakdown.reason: The agent failed to fix the inconsistency. The incomplete prompt incorrectly stated to clamp the re-entrant cutout faces ('set u = 0 on the two cutout faces'). The ground truth corrected this to 'keep the re-entrant inner boundaries traction-free'. The agent, however, repeated the user's error by instructing to 'apply clamped boundary conditions (u = 0) on the two internal edges adjacent to the re-entrant corner'.
